import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
# ...
def compute_grad_cam(model, params, batch_stats, input_tensor, target_class):
    variables = {"params": params, "batch_stats": batch_stats}

    # 1. Forward pass to get activations at target layer
    activations, identity = model.apply(
        variables, input_tensor, method=ResNet18GradCAM.forward_to_target
    )

    # 2. Define function to compute class score from target activations
    def class_score_fn(target_acts):
        logits = model.apply(
            variables, target_acts, identity, method=ResNet18GradCAM.forward_from_target
        )
        return logits[0, target_class]

    # 3. Compute gradients w.r.t. activations
    gradients = jax.grad(class_score_fn)(activations)
    return activations, gradients
# ...
